FinalAudioCheck.description: A deterministic audio-mix check, located against the global timeline.
FinalAudioCheck.title: FinalAudioCheck

FinalCaptionCheck.description: A deterministic caption check, located against a cue and its narration.
FinalCaptionCheck.title: FinalCaptionCheck

FinalCheckType.description: Which deterministic family produced a persisted check row.
FinalCheckType.title: FinalCheckType

FinalDeterministicCheck.description: One deterministic media or timeline check with its measurement.
FinalDeterministicCheck.title: FinalDeterministicCheck

FinalEditorialAdjudication.description: One bounded Terra second opinion over disputed first-pass findings.
FinalEditorialAdjudication.title: FinalEditorialAdjudication

FinalEditorialCategory.description: The bounded editorial dimensions T22 evaluates on the assembled recap.
FinalEditorialCategory.title: FinalEditorialCategory

FinalEditorialDimension.description:
One recomputed editorial dimension result.

``score`` is descriptive only. The gate reads findings, never this number:
a high average must never conceal a blocking issue.
FinalEditorialDimension.title: FinalEditorialDimension

FinalEditorialEvidence.description: Exact, resolvable evidence for one finding. Never bytes, never a URL.
FinalEditorialEvidence.title: FinalEditorialEvidence

FinalEditorialFinding.description: One canonical finding. Provider prose never reaches this model unbounded.
FinalEditorialFinding.title: FinalEditorialFinding

FinalFindingSeverity.description: Severity is structural, never derived from an average score.
FinalFindingSeverity.title: FinalFindingSeverity

FinalGateDecision.description: The completion gate's recomputed decision for one render identity.
FinalGateDecision.title: FinalGateDecision

FinalIssueCode.description: The bounded structured issue taxonomy. Adding a member is a version change.
FinalIssueCode.title: FinalIssueCode

FinalMediaMeasurements.description: Every measured property of the assembled render, with its tool versions.
FinalMediaMeasurements.title: FinalMediaMeasurements

FinalQAConfiguration.description:
Versioned thresholds. Every value here is bound into the final-QA identity.

Changing any threshold is a configuration change, which produces a new
identity and therefore a new run rather than silently re-grading an old one.
FinalQAConfiguration.title: FinalQAConfiguration

FinalQAInput.description:
The exact canonical inputs one final-QA run was bound to.

Every field is part of the input hash. A newer selected animation, a new
render, a rebuilt caption asset or a different approved script produces a
different hash and therefore a different run: a report is never reused for
material that changed.
FinalQAInput.title: FinalQAInput

FinalRemediationRoute.description: One structured remediation route derived from confirmed findings.
FinalRemediationRoute.title: FinalRemediationRoute

FinalRemediationTarget.description: Where a confirmed issue is routed. T22 never executes the route itself.
FinalRemediationTarget.title: FinalRemediationTarget

FinalSelectedShot.description: One selected shot as the render manifest recorded it, with its QA lineage.
FinalSelectedShot.title: FinalSelectedShot

description: The immutable persisted report. Never overwritten, never reused.
title: FinalEditorialReport
